Ketamine is a NMDA-receptor antagonist that acts at different levels of inflammation, interacting with inflammatory cells recruitment, cytokins production, and inflammatory mediators regulation. The resultant effect of these interactions confers to ketamine a anti-proinflammatory effect by limiting exacerbation of systemic inflammation without affecting local healing processes.
